examples.title: Basic empty state
examples.description: A first-use state: title, one sentence and a primary button.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, EmptyState } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<EmptyState
  title="No hooks yet"
  description="A hook does something when an event happens: send a webhook, start a workflow, or notify you."
>
  {#snippet action()}
    <Button variant="primary" label="New hook" />
  {/snippet}
</EmptyState>

examples.title: Every kind
examples.description: Why a view is empty sets the disc: first use is accent with a primary button, filtered is neutral with a secondary Clear filters, done is green with a secondary button, blocked is amber, not-found is neutral and disabled is neutral with a plug, for content a setting you chose holds back.
examples.code: {#snippet action()}

examples.title: A list page's first use
examples.description: Under a page header: top-aligned at one offset, never boxed, a 60-character measure, the page's own icon, and its actions drawn as buttons with the header's verb. A tab or a section draws the same state.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { EmptyState } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import { Target } from '@lucide/svelte';
</script>

<EmptyState
  headingLevel={2}
  title="No goals yet"
  description="A goal runs an agent on a prompt until a check passes."
  actions={[
    { label: 'New goal', href: '/goals/new' },
    { label: 'Ask an agent', href: '/chats/new' },
  ]}
>
  {#snippet icon()}<Target aria-hidden="true" />{/snippet}
</EmptyState>
